features.title: Project skeleton: FastAPI backend + React/Vite frontend + Docker compose
acceptance: Backend runs with FastAPI and health endpoint
Frontend builds with Vite + TypeScript + React
Docker compose starts both services + Keycloak
Basic pytest and vitest tests pass

features.title: OIDC authentication with Keycloak (authorization code + PKCE)
acceptance: Callback exchanges code for tokens with PKCE
Access token used for authenticated API calls
Tests cover unauthenticated rejection and role denial

features.title: Bounded media range responses (fixes connection starvation)
acceptance: Open-ended Range requests capped at 4 MB
Multiple video elements don't starve connections

features.title: LLM provider adapters (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama)
